reporting-org.narrative: Internationella Kvinnoförbundet för Fred och Frihet

description.narrative: WILPF Cameroon are partners to WILPF Sweden (IKFF) and one of the organisations implementing the Transformative Partnership Program (TPP). Considering this socio-political context in which the implementation of the TPP comes, WILPF Cameroon shall operate with heightened vigilance and resilience. In this volatile environment, WILPF Cameroon will continue its mission as a peace actor while strengthening its internal protection mechanisms. The project positions WILPF Cameroon to survive, adapt and continue advancing its peace mandate in a rapid changing context where defending rights and calling for restraint has become both indispensable and dangerous. The strategic orientation of the TPP therefore aims at the same time to consolidate the organization’s institutional gains and sustain its advocacy for Women/Youth, Peace and Security agendas, and to ensure the safety, wellbeing and operational continuity of its members. The grant aims to enhance internal coordination, impact in advocacy, communication and conflict prevention, while deepening the organization’s presence and action at the local level. In a spirit of innovation and intergenerational transition, the TPP will also include a focus on developing the Youth Peace movement.
